verdict.rationale: Pika documents several ways to bring stills into motion. Pikaframes turns 2–5 keyframe images into a video with prompt-guided motion, a character photo can be animated using motion from a reference clip, a portrait can be animated with lip sync, and a product image can become a video ad. However, there is no explicit general single-image-to-video feature, and no documented claim that subject and composition are preserved. missing for 10: explicit single-image animate/image-to-video documentation, evidence of subject/composition fidelity, independent or hands-on corroboration.
